title: Lovely Spicy Mexican Almond Burrito
description: A spicy and comforting Mexican dish featuring almond paste, perfect for a dairy-free diet, wrapped in a large burrito. This shaggy burrito is filled with flavorful ingredients to satisfy your cravings.

ingredients.name: roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers and onions

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the almond paste, cooked brown rice, black beans, roasted vegetables, and diced tomatoes.
Add the spicy salsa to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Warm the tortilla wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the burritos by spooning the filling onto the center of each tortilla wrap.
Top the filling with shredded lettuce, diced avocado, and nutritional yeast if using.
Fold the bottom edge of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the burrito up tightly.
Place the burritos seam-side down on a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes.
Serve the burritos hot and enjoy.
